errors.evidence: The description states there are five categories, but the pie chart clearly shows six categories: дизел (diesel), бензин (petrol), електрически (electric), хибридни (hybrid), plug-n хибрид (plug-in hybrid), and други (other).
The description completely omits the 'дизел' (diesel) category, which represents 12.70% of the total and is the fourth-largest segment in the chart.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the segment following the electric cars (14.40%) is the plug-in hybrids (6.10%). The actual next segment in descending order is diesel cars at 12.70%. The description misrepresents the ranking of the categories by omitting the diesel segment.
